subject: general
question: Price control and rationing are direct control measures to check ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**inflation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Price control** and **rationing** are direct measures used by governments to manage and control **inflation**.
 
• Inflation refers to the general increase in prices and the fall in the purchasing value of money.
 
• Price control involves setting a maximum price level for essential goods to prevent them from becoming unaffordable during high inflation periods.
 
• Rationing ensures the equitable distribution of scarce resources by limiting the amount of goods each individual can purchase.
 
• These measures are typically used in situations where inflation is driven by supply shortages or excessive demand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inflation control** is crucial for maintaining economic stability and ensuring the affordability of goods and services.
 
• Other measures to control inflation include monetary policy adjustments, such as increasing interest rates, and fiscal policies like reducing government spending.
 
• Governments may also use subsidies and tax reductions to offset the impact of rising prices on consumers.
 
• Effective inflation management helps in sustaining economic growth and protecting the purchasing power of the currency.
 
• Long-term inflation control strategies involve improving production efficiency and increasing the supply of goods and services.
